mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, COALESCE(v.name, r.name, '') AS agent_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.icon')) AS agent_icon, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.color')) AS agent_color FROM agent_conversation c JOIN resource r ON r.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND r.id = COALESCE(c.agent_id, c.preview_resource_id) LEFT JOIN resource_version v ON v.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND v.id = c.agent_version_id
